revisions.prompt: During preparation for the customer support review, answer the account question from the Salesforce account through the service workflow in the Slack connect channel, informing the customer room’s next-response decision.

As the budget review approaches, continue the long-running analysis of Snowflake’s finance view and post conclusions to Slack’s private channel, helping the finance private audience decide which variances need follow-up.
To inform the scheduled Total Rewards review, share the benefits guide from Drive through a Drive shared link with the named benefits broker, enabling a delivery-date decision.

With the certificate lifecycle review nearing, use Drive’s certificate document to prepare a certificate rotation summary and post it to Slack’s private channel for identity operations, supporting the rotation timing decision.

When preparing the planned connector token review, publish an internal connector validation packet from Drive’s connector packet as a GitHub issue for connector engineering, supporting the validation-readiness decision.

In preparation for the control attestation review, move Drive control evidence through the review worksheet and attach it to the Salesforce case, supporting the compliance team’s completeness decision.

As corporate development prepares for the acquisition diligence review, create the schedule from Drive’s inherited diligence folder and add it to the Salesforce account, supporting corporate development’s sequencing decision.
For discussion at the growth portfolio review, turn Drive customer feedback into an expansion brief and post it to the growth team channel in Slack, supporting account-prioritization decisions.
Before the implementation review, convert the implementation note from the Drive document into a Slack channel update for the implementation team, enabling its decision on next rollout steps.
To frame the operations review, summarize the shared planning document in Drive and share it through the operations team’s Slack channel, informing work-sequencing decisions.
As service delivery considers routing at the service intake review, prepare a service response through the intake workflow from the Drive service intake and enter it in the Salesforce case.
During portfolio review preparation, condense Drive’s inherited portfolio planning document into a Salesforce account entry, helping the portfolio team decide project sequencing.
When the procurement team meets for the supplier exception review, build the packet from the Drive procurement exception and add it to the Salesforce case so the team can decide disposition.
At the release management review, post a summary of the release note from the private GitHub repository in Slack for the engineering team, supporting the release timing decision.
To enable the planned dependency release review, turn the GitHub dependency lock into a GitHub pull request so software assurance can decide whether to advance the release.
Before the hotfix release review, publish a pull request in GitHub using the GitHub release file, allowing hotfix reviewers to decide whether deployment should proceed.
For consideration at the IAM policy release review, create a GitHub pull request from the GitHub policy file so security reviewers can decide release readiness.

As the long-running incident review continues, deepen the examination of GitHub’s private repository and post conclusions in Slack’s private channel, supporting the incident team’s decision on investigative threads.
During change audit meeting preparation, create a release audit from the private GitHub repository in a Drive document, supporting the release audit team’s follow-up decision.

With the release management review approaching, publish GitHub’s release manifest as an internal release manifest in a Drive document for the release team, supporting the milestone-sequencing decision.
To guide the commission review meeting, turn the Salesforce opportunity into a commission review summary in Drive so sales compensation can decide follow-up actions.
When the deal room convenes for the deal review, assemble the quote review packet from the Salesforce quote and save it as a Drive document so the deal room can decide next steps.
As people operations prepares for the employee mobility review, prepare the brief from the Salesforce employee contact in Drive so the team can decide transition next steps.

To equip integration security for the integration response review, create an OAuth integration incident summary from the Salesforce integration record and write it to a Drive document, supporting its follow-up sequencing decision.
To frame the planned parent account review, assemble Salesforce’s related account view into a parent-subsidiary brief and create it as a Drive document for account strategy’s coverage decision.
To support priority decisions in the partner pipeline review, prepare the update from the Salesforce account list and publish it in the Slack connect channel for the partner pipeline room.
During the partner quote review, summarize the Salesforce quote and post the partner quote summary in the Slack connect channel so the partner deal room can decide how to proceed.
For the pricing review meeting, prepare a margin summary from the Salesforce quote and post it in a Slack private channel so the pricing team can decide quote positioning.
When the territory review convenes, build a territory-transfer account brief using account context in Salesforce and publish it in a Slack channel for the territory team’s coverage decision.
To clarify ownership during the planned app token review, publish the Slack app thread as an internal app integration handoff in a Salesforce case, supporting business systems’ ownership decision.
Drawing on Slack message search for the scheduled operations review, create a Drive document summarizing the discussion to support the operations team’s decision on follow-up priorities.
As the vendor incident review approaches, turn Slack’s incident thread into an update within the GitHub issue for vendor issue readers, supporting the vendor-response decision.
Continuing the long-running legal matter review, examine Slack’s private channel further and capture findings in the Drive document, helping legal operations decide which items need more examination.
To inform the scheduled security decision review, distill the thread found by Slack message search into a GitHub issue supporting security engineering’s decision on implementation direction.
Following termination, create a GitHub issue for engineering governance using findings from the private Slack channel for the contractor access review, supporting decisions on follow-up actions.
During the vendor portfolio review, answer the status request from Slack’s vendor thread in the Salesforce case, supporting the decision on subsequent vendor follow-up.
To guide billing operations’ resolution decision at the billing dispute review, assemble the joined view available in Snowflake into a dispute brief and publish it in the private Slack channel.
Supporting the regional people team’s staffing-priority decision at the regional workforce review, develop the brief from Snowflake’s regional table and share it through Slack’s private channel.
To help channel sales decide partner coverage priorities at the reseller portfolio review, turn Snowflake’s partner table into a reseller portfolio brief and store it as a Drive document.
At the scheduled access audit review, prepare the audit from Snowflake’s scheduled service view in a Drive document so the audit team can determine follow-up scope.
With the spend control review on the agenda, turn the Snowflake spend exception view into a spend control exception report in a Drive document so finance controls can decide how to handle it.
As regional support weighs workload balancing for the regional support review, create the workload brief from Snowflake’s territory table and attach it to the Salesforce case.
To support the territory team’s coverage-priority decision at the territory planning review, develop the pipeline brief from the Snowflake table and publish it in Slack’s channel.
